title: A two-day offsite for a team of 14
about: Plan · what you get, what to decide, what could go wrong
tldr: Two days out of the office: day one on next year's plan, day two on how the team works. You get an agenda, a budget and the invite. Two questions for you, and two edge cases worth a look.

edgeCases.title: Three people can't travel
edgeCases.line: Day one is about the plan, which they need to hear.
edgeCases.happens: Three of 14 miss the plan they'll work to.
edgeCases.consider: A call-in for the morning, or a recap the next week led by Priya.

edgeCases.title: The venue cancels a week before
edgeCases.line: The second quote holds until the end of the month.
edgeCases.happens: You lose the venue with a week to go.
edgeCases.consider: Book the second venue's hold now; it costs nothing until the end of the month.
